entities.name: Query BioD protein
observations: 234 aa soluble enzyme; calculated molecular mass 24.94 kDa and theoretical pI 5.22.
Exact full-length sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A1U4A9, an ATP-dependent dethiobiotin synthetase BioD.
Pfam matches: AAA_26 (PF13500) and CbiA (PF01656), spanning most of the sequence.
Curated homolog annotations support cytosolic localization, Mg2+ dependence, ATP binding, and homodimerization.

entities.name: BioD dethiobiotin synthetase
observations: EC 6.3.3.3; catalyzes ATP-dependent insertion of CO2 between N7 and N8 of 7,8-diaminopelargonic acid to form the ureido ring of dethiobiotin.
Uses Mg2+ as cofactor/metal ion and participates in the biotin biosynthesis pathway.
Reference reaction: (7R,8S)-7,8-diammoniononanoate + CO2 + ATP = (4R,5S)-dethiobiotin + ADP + phosphate + 3 H+.

entities.name: RHEA:15805
observations: ATP-dependent carboxylation/cyclization of 7,8-diaminopelargonic acid to dethiobiotin with ADP and phosphate formation; CO2 is inserted between the two amino nitrogens to create the ureido ring.
